project: Leshen-KMC validation and CO2RR C2 selectivity study
goal: Phase 1: Validate Leshen-KMC with HER on Pt(111). Phase 2: Investigate CO* spatial distribution effects on C2 selectivity in CO2RR on Cu(100) — first electrocatalytic spatial KMC study of C-C coupling

requirements.description: Phase 1: Build and validate HER Pt(111) model (Volmer/Tafel/Heyrovsky, lateral, diffusion, polarization curve)
Phase 2: Build CO2RR Cu(100) model with CO* dimerization, lateral interactions, diffusion
Phase 2: Investigate CO* spatial distribution (island vs uniform) and its effect on C2 selectivity
Phase 2: Compare KMC vs MKM predictions for C1/C2 selectivity — quantify mean-field error
Phase 2: Study CO* diffusion rate and lateral interaction strength as tuning knobs for C2 selectivity
Generate polarization curves and Faradaic efficiency vs potential for CO2RR
